news.title: Mechanic work is now cinematic
news.body: The latest server update replaces mechanic mouse minigames with automatic work scenes. Test repairs, all four wheels, pads and discs, oil, spark plugs, scanning and paint. Backspace cancels; lift controls remain manual. Check that cancelling restores the car and removes tools and cameras.

news.title: Paint booth and mechanic cameras
news.body: Sanding, colour and clear coat now play automatically. Camera wall detection has been corrected, views switch without travelling through walls, and the overhead paint shot is gone. Test narrow booths and different cars; report any view outside the building or mechanic getting stuck.

news.title: Lift controls, hood and parts
news.body: Lift controls are on the black-and-white unit on the blue post. The hood closes after engine work, and the job-step panel now uses Clearly styling. Mechanic parts, tools and custom engines can stack. Please check lift access with a parked car and inventory stacking.

news.title: Death effect and flood recovery
news.body: The death blackout now waits 800 ms before starting. Flood swimming recovery and water rendering also received fixes. Test the death effect timing, then check swimming and returning to normal movement during a staff-run flood test.

news.title: Help us catch the remaining bugs
news.body: These changes still need in-game verification after the server receives its latest update. Report the action, location, vehicle model and what happened in Discord; a short clip helps. News refreshes when you reopen the launcher, without installing a new version.

news.title: Join the Discord
news.body: Announcements, events and support all happen there. Read the rules before you set foot in town.

news.title: Mechanic cinematics and camera fixes
news.body: Test automatic repair, servicing, scanner and paint scenes after the latest server update. Backspace should cancel cleanly, the hood should close after engine work, and cameras should stay inside the shop. Lift controls remain manual, on the post's black-and-white unit.

news.title: Blackout, floods and inventory
news.body: Check the new 800 ms delay before death blackout, flood swimming recovery and water rendering during staff-run tests, and stacking mechanic parts, tools and custom engines. Report reproducible failures in Discord.

news.title: Dev and Live share the test server
news.body: Both launcher channels currently point at the same server. Expect restarts and unfinished work. News updates separately from the launcher installer; reopen the launcher to fetch the latest cards.
